hook.prompt: Cinematic photo, vertical: a paper coffee cup with steam on a cafe counter at sunrise, a smartphone beside it showing a generic payment app screen with a glowing balance, warm morning light, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, no logos, no brand names, plain cup

scenes.narration: Is Starbucks holding your money right now? It might be.
At the end of 2025, customers had about 2 billion dollars sitting on Starbucks cards and in its rewards program.

visual.label: on Starbucks cards and rewards, Dec 2025

scenes.narration: That's money Starbucks gets up front, before you order anything. It's basically an interest free loan from its customers.
And some of it never gets spent. In one recent year, Starbucks counted about 200 million dollars from card balances it expects nobody will ever use.

visual.label: from card money never spent, in one year

scenes.narration: So that forgotten gift card in your drawer is quietly Starbucks profit. Follow for more.
